data.body: **[P2] Enforce exporter ownership across plugin instances.** Duplicate validation only covers one config, while each plugin creates an independent scheduler. Reusing one exporter object in two `WorkflowInsightPlugin` instances—permitted by the core plugin list—therefore starts two workers that can call `export()` or `flush()` concurrently, although `InsightExporter` does not require thread safety. Share lanes by exporter identity or reject an exporter already owned by another plugin, and test two plugins constructed from the same config.
